title: Florida House, District 2
what_it_does: Represents District 2 (Parts of Escambia, Santa Rosa) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Jon Fay
candidates.occupation: Director of surplus solutions at Airline MRO Parts; retired U.S. Navy commander
candidates.background: Jon Fay, a 2000 Naval Academy graduate, served 24 years as a naval flight officer, including as executive officer of the Blue Angels and as a Navy legislative fellow in the U.S. House, before retiring as a commander in 2024. He now works in the aviation parts industry and won the August 2026 Republican primary with 78% of the vote.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

taxes.summary: He pledges to support the local economy through infrastructure investment and lower taxes.
taxes.quote: Support our local economy through infrastructure investments and lower taxes

sources.title: WEAR: Jon Fay wins Florida House District 2 Republican Primary to replace Rep. Andrade

crime.summary: He pledges to enforce the rule of law and work with President Trump and Gov. DeSantis to keep Florida safe.
crime.quote: Enforce the rule of law and work with President Trump and Governor DeSantis to keep Florida safe

trump.summary: His platform commits to working with President Trump and Gov. DeSantis on public safety.

veterans.summary: He pledges to fight for the veteran and active-duty community and keep Florida the most veteran-friendly state.
veterans.quote: Fight for our veteran and active-duty community to help keep Florida the most veteran-friendly state

other_issues.title: Insurance
other_issues.summary: Fay says he will prioritize pro-consumer policies to bring down auto and homeowners insurance costs, without specifying a regulatory or market approach.

candidates.name: Johnny Thompson
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Harvard Law School student (with concurrent public-health graduate study)
candidates.background: Johnny Austin Thompson is a Pensacola native and product of Escambia County public schools who is studying law at Harvard while pursuing graduate work in public health. He grew up in a working-class family that at times relied on SNAP and government health coverage, and he was unopposed for the Democratic nomination.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

healthcare.summary: Thompson proposes expanding Medicaid to cover doula, midwife and telehealth maternal services and campaigns on protecting health care access.
healthcare.quote: Expanding Medicaid to cover doula and midwife services, as well as telemedicine for remote maternal health consultations

sources.title: Daily Kos: Florida Maternal Mortality Is a Preventable Crisis for Black Mothers (by Johnny Austin Thompson)

property_tax.summary: His campaign pledges to cut property taxes for District 2 families.
property_tax.quote: cut property taxes for District 2 families

abortion.summary: In an essay on maternal mortality he wrote that addressing the impact of abortion bans and restrictive policies is critical, citing worse outcomes in states with restrictive laws.
abortion.quote: Addressing the impact of abortion bans and restrictive policies is critical

sources.title: Daily Kos: Florida Maternal Mortality Is a Preventable Crisis for Black Mothers (by Johnny Austin Thompson)

other_issues.title: Universal free school meals
other_issues.summary: Thompson supports universal free school meals in Florida public schools, citing his own childhood reliance on SNAP.

sources.title: Daily Kos: I Grew Up Relying on SNAP. Now I'm Running to Make Sure No Child Learns Hungry (by Johnny Austin Thompson)

other_issues.title: Public schools
other_issues.summary: His site pledges to fully fund public schools and protect a clean Gulf Coast.
